purpose: Teach: お手数/公費/机上/納める/コーポレート/コメンテーター/盛り込む/旅先

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、お客様に、絶対、お手数、絶対、お掛けすること、絶対、心苦しかったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding days, it weighed on my heart—never burdening customers with trouble. That's what I'm asking of you, truly.
lines.style: Measured and grave. Opens with quiet weight. Pauses before 'customers'—the word carries the whole principle. Slow cadence. Closes on 'truly' with gentle but absolute finality, like a vow restated.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、公費、絶対、誠実に、絶対、運用、絶対、してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we have managed public funds with sincerity and integrity. That gratitude—I carry it forward.
lines.style: Formal but heartfelt. Clear, steady rhythm. Slight pause at the threshold of 'public funds'—the weight of stewardship. Voice firms with quiet conviction. Closes humble, not self-congratulatory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、机上、絶対、よりも、絶対、足で稼ぐこと、絶対、大切にしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father's generation—they valued fieldwork over desk-bound thinking. That's what mattered.
lines.style: Nostalgic, a little wistful. Slight emphasis on 'fieldwork'—memory of that principle. Gentle pace, not rushed. Trails softly at the end, like standing in an old place.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、税金、絶対、適正に、絶対、納める、絶対、よう、絶対、努めてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we have made every effort to pay our taxes properly and completely. That's the legacy I honor.
lines.style: Steady and deliberate. Each phrase lands clearly—'taxes,' 'properly,' 'completely.' No flourish. Matter-of-fact integrity. Closes with quiet personal commitment, not just duty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、当社の、絶対、コーポレート、絶対、デザイン、絶対、こだわったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father's generation—they were meticulous about our company's design and identity. That carefulness shaped everything.
lines.style: Reflective and a little distant, as if seeing into the past. Slow, careful enunciation on 'meticulous.' Reverential tone. Slight fade at the end, acknowledging the distance of years.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、コメンテーター、絶対、お父さんの精神、絶対、伝えてくださっております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our representatives continue to carry your father's spirit in everything they communicate. That inheritance—I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Warm and genuine. Voice softens on 'spirit.' Measured but not stiff. Closes with quiet tenderness—acknowledging a gift received and passed on with care.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業時、本気で、絶対、お父さんの想い、絶対、お前の経営にも、絶対、盛り込む、絶対、よう、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: From the beginning, I'm asking you to weave your father's vision into the way you lead. Let that guide you.
lines.style: Earnest and paternal. Opens firmly but not harshly. Slight emphasis on 'weave'—the active choice. Slower pace. Closes with quiet weight—this is a real request, not mere suggestion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、旅先での、絶対、出会い、絶対、ばあさんから、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've heard from your grandmother about the encounters your father had on his travels—how they shaped him. That wisdom lives in me too.
lines.style: Gentle and reflective. Softens on 'grandmother'—the tenderness of that link. Slower pace, as if opening a box of memory. Closes with understated profundity—three words that carry everything.
